head: codex/92-runtime-tls-standardization
title: [v0.92][runtime-v3] Unify TLS/mTLS and retire self-signed Runtime certificates
body:
Closes #92

## Summary

- make Axum the sole Runtime HTTP/HTTPS/WSS stack using one shared TLS 1.3 Rustls/AWS-LC identity and trust policy
- retain Quinn only for Guardian-to-Guardian QUIC while reusing the shared Rustls mTLS policy
- remove Runtime self-signed issuance, certificate reissue, host trust mutation, and verification shortcuts
- consume externally provisioned CA-issued certificates and keep public TLS, Guardian mTLS, and application authority distinct
- make the kernel Axum ACIP route and served OpenAPI document canonical, with a separate ACIP write credential

## Validation

- Axum/TLS control: 23 passed
- shared TLS policy: 3 passed
- Observatory/ACIP: 7 passed
- exact production kernel ACIP/WSS proof: 1 passed
- Guardian Quinn mTLS: 14 passed
- protocol mTLS: 13 passed
- external-certificate lifecycle fixture: 1 passed
- served OpenAPI contract: 6 passed
- exact-head independent review: PASS
- diff hygiene: PASS
